resources.string: Your AI wingman for Tinder, Bumble, Hinge & Instagram DMs.\n\nGet 5 clever, personalised replies in seconds — right from your keyboard.

To use MatchCraft while typing in a dating app, add it in:

Settings → System → Language & Input → On-screen Keyboard → Manage keyboards

Toggle MatchCraft AI Keyboard on.

MatchCraft needs internet access to reach the AI service.

⚡ Privacy promise:
We NEVER log your keystrokes or read anything you type. The AI only processes an image you explicitly paste — nothing else, ever.

How to use it:

1. Open Tinder, Bumble, Hinge or Instagram
2. Tap any text field
3. Switch to MatchCraft using the keyboard icon
4. Tap ✨, paste a screenshot, pick a tone
5. Tap a suggestion to insert it
Paste a screenshot first. Copy a profile image or chat screenshot to your clipboard, then tap Paste.
Internet access is needed to reach the AI. Make sure the keyboard is enabled in Settings.
Tap a suggestion to insert it:
Enable a persistent bubble that floats over any app. Tap it to get AI replies without leaving Tinder or Instagram.
